Reconstruct the visible indoor scene from one RGB photograph using SceneAct and Blender.
Infer geometry and a camera matching the reference viewpoint, perspective and framing.
Use separate 3D meshes for architecture, furniture and visible objects, preserving colors,
proportions, placement, occlusions and materials. Do not use the reference as a texture,
background or projected image. No ground-truth calibration or other views are available.

Return a complete, runnable Python program inside one ```python code block. Each execution
starts in a fresh Blender process. Programs can use numpy, sceneact and bpy. Use SceneAct
for geometry and relationships; bpy may customize lighting, materials and camera settings.
Do not render or save files in the program: the fixed runner saves and renders once after
execution, using your active camera. Do not access external files, network or other models.
When satisfied after inspecting a rendering, reply exactly DONE. The last successful build
is submitted automatically. Budget includes all planning, corrections and review calls.

SceneAct API (all coordinates in a world frame with Z up; angles in degrees):
from sceneact import *
Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)
parent.include(name, node) attaches an asset/part while preserving its world position.
parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)
rod(radius, start=(x,y,z), end=(x,y,z), color=(1,1,1))
rod(radius, length=h, center=(0,0,0), axis='+z', color=(1,1,1))
fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

Example:
from sceneact import *
scene = Scene()
table = Asset('table')
table.include('top', box((1.4,.8,.08), center=(0,0,.75), color=(.4,.2,.1)))
for x in (-.6,.6):
    for y in (-.3,.3):
        table.include(f'leg_{x}_{y}', box((.07,.07,.7), center=(x,y,.35)))
scene.include('table', table)
scene.include('floor', box((6,6,.1), center=(0,0,-.05), color=(.6,.6,.6)))
realize(scene)
set_view((3,-4,2), (0,0,.7), lens=40)
area_emitter((0,-2,4), power=1000)

from sceneact import *
import bpy, math, random
from mathutils import Vector
random.seed(8)
scene=Scene('Victorian bedroom')
wood=(.085,.043,.025)
gold=(.42,.32,.075)
ivory=(.78,.77,.66)
def add(n,o):
    scene.include(n,o)
    return o
def bx(n,s,c,col):
    return add(n,box(s,center=c,color=col))
def bar(n,a,b,r,col):
    return add(n,rod(r,start=a,end=b,color=col))
def orb(n,c,s,col):
    o=ball(1,center=c,color=col)
    o.resize(s)
    return add(n,o)

# The room and its pale stone floor.
bx('limestone floor',(8,11,.14),(0,-.6,-.08),(.57,.55,.49))
bx('rear wallpaper',(7.5,.16,3.5),(-.35,3.5,1.75),(.43,.35,.26))
bx('right wallpaper',(.16,10.5,3.5),(3.35,-1.65,1.75),(.44,.36,.28))
for z,w,h in [(3.39,.15,.16),(3.28,.10,.07),(3.20,.055,.045)]:
    bx('rear cornice '+str(z),(7.6,w,h),(-.35,3.36,z),(.86,.87,.83))
    bx('side cornice '+str(z),(w,10.5,h),(3.21,-1.65,z),(.86,.87,.83))
bx('back skirting',(7.5,.075,.18),(-.35,3.36,.09),(.25,.19,.12))
bx('right skirting',(.08,10,.18),(3.24,-1.6,.09),(.25,.19,.12))

# Tall, deeply framed sash windows with green blinds.
for i,(x,w) in enumerate([(-3.28,1.18),(-1.05,1.43)]):
    bx('window luminous glass '+str(i),(w,.035,2.60),(x,3.365,1.81),(.84,.95,.94))
    for dx in [-w/2,w/2]:
        bx('window outer upright '+str(i)+str(dx),(.105,.19,2.79),(x+dx,3.25,1.83),(.88,.9,.87))
        bx('window inner upright '+str(i)+str(dx),(.035,.07,2.57),(x+dx*.91,3.13,1.81),(.68,.73,.70))
    for z in [.46,3.19]:
        bx('window molding '+str(i)+str(z),(w+.19,.18,.09),(x,3.25,z),(.93,.94,.90))
    bx('window sill '+str(i),(w+.25,.34,.09),(x,3.17,.48),(.82,.84,.80))
    bx('green roller blind '+str(i),(w-.12,.035,1.18),(x,3.19,2.45),(.13,.31,.28))
    bar('blind bottom '+str(i),(x-w/2+.06,3.15,1.86),(x+w/2-.06,3.15,1.86),.018,(.34,.46,.39))
    bx('lower sash '+str(i),(.037,.055,1.25),(x,3.14,1.12),(.89,.91,.87))
    bx('window horizontal sash '+str(i),(w-.1,.07,.045),(x,3.14,1.15),(.87,.89,.86))

# A narrow white door behind the painted folding screen.
bx('door casing',( .74,.13,2.36),(1.12,3.30,1.18),(.89,.89,.82))
bx('white door',(.62,.045,2.22),(1.12,3.20,1.15),(.73,.77,.72))
for z,h in [(.70,.85),(1.73,.88)]:
    bx('door inset '+str(z),(.49,.025,h),(1.12,3.165,z),(.68,.73,.69))
orb('door handle',(1.34,3.10,1.15),(.035,.035,.035),(.42,.31,.10))

# Portraits: oval gold frame, dark field and painted sitter.
def oval_portrait(x,z,w,h):
    orb('gilded oval outer',(x,3.235,z),(w/2,.045,h/2),(.61,.43,.13))
    orb('gilded oval inner',(x,3.175,z),(w*.445,.025,h*.45),(.29,.19,.065))
    orb('portrait black field',(x,3.14,z),(w*.405,.018,h*.415),(.035,.029,.024))
    orb('portrait shoulders',(x,3.112,z-h*.16),(w*.26,.012,h*.15),(.075,.047,.033))
    orb('portrait face',(x+.015,3.105,z+h*.085),(w*.105,.012,h*.13),(.43,.28,.17))
    orb('portrait hair',(x-.013,3.099,z+h*.16),(w*.11,.012,h*.075),(.08,.048,.025))
    bar('portrait collar',(x-.06,3.08,z-.015),(x+.035,3.08,z-.06),.012,(.70,.62,.46))
oval_portrait(-2.28,2.24,.72,.91)

def picture(name,x,z,w,h,side=False,y=0):
    if not side:
        bx(name+' gold frame',(w,.065,h),(x,3.20,z),(.54,.41,.20))
        bx(name+' mat',(w-.05,.022,h-.05),(x,3.15,z),(.80,.79,.69))
        bx(name+' print',(w*.65,.018,h*.72),(x,3.13,z),(.48,.48,.42))
        orb(name+' bust',(x,3.108,z-.04),(w*.18,.013,h*.23),(.29,.29,.26))
        orb(name+' head',(x,3.096,z+.10),(w*.115,.012,h*.13),(.36,.35,.30))
    else:
        bx(name+' frame',(.065,w,h),(3.20,y,z),(.58,.44,.22))
        bx(name+' paper',(.02,w-.055,h-.055),(3.15,y,z),(.79,.77,.66))
        orb(name+' cameo',(3.12,y,z),(.015,w*.25,h*.34),(.42,.40,.34))
picture('small framed engraving',.32,2.54,.43,.59)
picture('side oval engraving',0,2.49,.36,.56,True,2.55)

# A dark antique bed, with its footboard toward the camera.
bedx=2.03
for x in [1.06,3.0]:
    for y in [-1.36,1.85]:
        bx('bed turned post '+str((x,y)),(.105,.105,.79),(x,y,.48),wood)
        orb('bed post finial '+str((x,y)),(x,y,.93 if y<0 else 1.23),(.075,.075,.085),wood)
        if y>0:
            bx('head tall post '+str(x),(.09,.10,1.18),(x,y,.65),wood)
bar('headboard top rail',(1.06,1.85,1.23),(3,1.85,1.23),.055,wood)
bx('headboard panel',(1.85,.11,.68),(bedx,1.85,.84),(.115,.064,.039))
for x in [1.11,2.96]:
    bx('bed long side rail '+str(x),(.10,3.18,.28),(x,.24,.37),wood)
bx('bed mattress',(1.82,3.10,.24),(bedx,.22,.59),(.61,.61,.52))
add('soft ivory cover',fillet_box((1.86,2.98,.28),radius=.13,center=(bedx,.15,.75),color=ivory))
bx('footboard main',(1.88,.13,.68),(bedx,-1.37,.54),(.105,.054,.031))
bx('footboard recessed panel',(1.60,.035,.37),(bedx,-1.448,.54),(.12,.065,.038))
bar('footboard polished top',(1.04,-1.39,.91),(3.02,-1.39,.91),.055,wood)
for x in [1.57,2.43]:
    p=fillet_box((.81,.70,.23),radius=.105,center=(x,1.25,.96),color=(.82,.82,.72))
    p.turn('x',20)
    p.turn('z',-5 if x<2 else 6)
    add('large cream pillow '+str(x),p)
# Folds at the edges of the cover.
for j in range(10):
    x=1.24+j*.16
    bar('cover foot fold '+str(j),(x,-1.28,.71),(x+.05,-1.08,.84),.012,(.64,.64,.54))

# Olive velvet armchair with a rounded, tufted back and sweeping arms.
cx=-.48; cy=-.67
for x in [cx-.48,cx+.48]:
    for y in [cy-.44,cy+.40]:
        bar('chair leg '+str((x,y)),(x,y,.07),(x-.025,y,.48),.037,(.15,.10,.045))
add('chair lower upholstery',fillet_box((1.12,.99,.31),radius=.14,center=(cx,cy,.43),color=(.29,.27,.055)))
orb('chair upholstered back',(cx,cy+.40,.96),(.57,.17,.66),(.34,.32,.075))
orb('chair back inset',(cx,cy+.235,.98),(.47,.065,.52),(.38,.35,.085))
add('chair seat cushion',fillet_box((.88,.79,.18),radius=.09,center=(cx,cy-.06,.60),color=(.38,.35,.075)))
for side in [-1,1]:
    x=cx+side*.52
    orb('chair arm side '+str(side),(x,cy-.06,.67),(.16,.55,.37),(.30,.28,.055))
    pts=[(x,cy-.52,.70),(x,cy-.39,.78),(x,cy+.02,.88),(x,cy+.35,1.10)]
    add('chair rolled arm '+str(side),sweep_tube(points=pts,radius=.075,color=(.40,.37,.085)))
for row in range(4):
    for col in range(3):
        x=cx+(col-1)*.22+(row%2)*.075
        z=.79+row*.18
        orb('velvet tuft '+str((row,col)),(x,cy+.162,z),(.026,.015,.025),(.21,.21,.035))
        for sign in [-1,1]:
            bar('tuft crease '+str((row,col,sign)),(x,cy+.165,z),(x+sign*.075,cy+.17,z+.08),.008,(.27,.26,.05))

# Three-panel painted screen, ochre ground, blue stylized decorations.
for i in range(3):
    x=.04+i*.49
    y=2.38+(.05 if i==1 else 0)
    bx('screen ochre panel '+str(i),(.49,.055,1.50),(x,y,1.12),(.55,.40,.17))
    for dx in [-.245,.245]:
        bar('screen upright '+str((i,dx)),(x+dx,y-.045,.33),(x+dx,y-.045,1.90),.016,(.12,.085,.04))
    bx('screen blue lower area '+str(i),(.45,.013,.36),(x,y-.038,.56),(.045,.10,.34))
    # Asymmetric blue islands and fan-shaped leaves.
    for k in range(5):
        xx=x+random.uniform(-.19,.19); zz=random.uniform(.72,1.79)
        o=orb('screen blue painted shape '+str((i,k)),(xx,y-.045,zz),(random.uniform(.10,.19),.009,random.uniform(.08,.24)),(.035,.10,.37))
        o.turn('y',random.uniform(-35,35))
    for k in range(3):
        xx=x+random.uniform(-.17,.17); zz=random.uniform(.60,1.72)
        orb('screen ochre leaf '+str((i,k)),(xx,y-.063,zz),(.072,.008,.12),(.64,.43,.13))
        bar('screen green stem '+str((i,k)),(xx-.04,y-.074,zz-.10),(xx+.035,y-.074,zz+.1),.006,(.12,.29,.20))
    for k in range(7):
        orb('screen little motif '+str((i,k)),(x+random.uniform(-.21,.21),y-.075,random.uniform(1.35,1.85)),(.015,.007,.018),(.22,.20,.12))

# A small white-clothed table below the portrait.
tx=-2.17; ty=2.65
bx('small table top',(.79,.56,.075),(tx,ty,.70),wood)
for dx in [-.31,.31]:
    for dy in [-.20,.20]:
        bar('small table leg '+str((dx,dy)),(tx+dx,ty+dy,.04),(tx+dx,ty+dy,.69),.026,wood)
bx('table white linen',(.83,.59,.018),(tx,ty,.752),(.83,.82,.72))
# Hanging triangular cloth, with an uneven edge.
cloth=box((.69,.018,.25),center=(tx,ty-.295,.62),color=(.82,.81,.72))
add('hanging tablecloth',cloth)
for x in [-2.41,-2.12,-1.94]:
    orb('table porcelain '+str(x),(x,2.62,.80),(.07,.065,.035),(.72,.73,.64))
    bar('table cup '+str(x),(x,2.62,.80),(x,2.62,.86),.026,(.78,.77,.65))
orb('small brass bowl',(-2.02,2.75,.80),(.09,.07,.035),(.46,.35,.10))
# Dark cabinet cropped at left.
bx('left chest',(.88,.55,.58),(-3.48,2.53,.32),(.10,.061,.032))
bx('left chest top',(.98,.63,.07),(-3.48,2.53,.64),(.12,.072,.035))
for z in [.20,.40,.55]:
    bx('chest drawer '+str(z),(.76,.035,.12),(-3.48,2.235,z),(.13,.079,.041))
    for x in [-3.70,-3.27]:
        orb('drawer knob '+str((x,z)),(x,2.205,z),(.021,.018,.021),(.48,.34,.13))
picture('miniature above chest',-3.48, .88,.30,.36)
# Thin black occasional chair behind the bed.
for x in [1.45,1.81]:
    for y in [2.37,2.72]:
        bar('black chair leg '+str((x,y)),(x,y,.04),(x,y,.52),.018,(.045,.034,.025))
bx('black chair seat',(.41,.43,.045),(1.63,2.52,.52),(.13,.12,.075))
for x in [1.45,1.81]:
    bar('black chair upright '+str(x),(x,2.73,.49),(x,2.73,1.04),.018,(.04,.032,.02))
bar('black chair crest',(1.44,2.73,1.04),(1.82,2.73,1.04),.024,wood)
for x in [1.53,1.64,1.74]:
    bar('chair spindle '+str(x),(x,2.73,.60),(x,2.73,1.03),.012,wood)
# Dark round bedside cabinet cropped on the right.
orb('round bedside cabinet',(3.35,-.33,.34),(.40,.40,.34),(.095,.058,.035))
orb('round bedside top',(3.35,-.33,.70),(.43,.43,.035),(.13,.08,.045))

# Small oriental rugs, made of layered woven borders.
def rug(name,x,y,w,h):
    colors=[(.34,.19,.13),(.57,.43,.30),(.24,.30,.30),(.62,.47,.32),(.44,.20,.13),(.61,.51,.36)]
    for i,c in enumerate(colors):
        bx(name+' border '+str(i),(w-i*.065,h-i*.065,.008),(x,y,.008+i*.002),c)
    for row in range(5):
        for col in range(7):
            xx=x+(col-3)*(w-.40)/7
            yy=y+(row-2)*(h-.36)/5
            o=box((.065,.065,.003),center=(xx,yy,.026),color=(.66,.55,.36))
            o.turn('z',45)
            add(name+' woven diamond '+str((row,col)),o)
rug('back carpet',-1.28,1.47,1.50,.97)
rug('foreground carpet',1.35,-2.05,1.95,.86)

realize(scene)

# Add the dense, faded floral texture to both wallpaper surfaces.
wallmat=bpy.data.materials.new('aged floral wallpaper')
wallmat.use_nodes=True
nt=wallmat.node_tree; n=nt.nodes; l=nt.links
bs=n.get('Principled BSDF')
bs.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=.95
tex=n.new('ShaderNodeTexNoise'); tex.inputs['Scale'].default_value=74
tex.inputs['Detail'].default_value=3.2
tex.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=.72
coord=n.new('ShaderNodeTexCoord')
l.new(coord.outputs['Generated'],tex.inputs['Vector'])
ramp=n.new('ShaderNodeValToRGB')
ramp.color_ramp.elements.remove(ramp.color_ramp.elements[1])
for pos,col in [(0,(.12,.16,.15,1)),(.35,(.22,.24,.20,1)),(.46,(.40,.31,.22,1)),(.55,(.52,.40,.27,1)),(.64,(.35,.27,.19,1)),(.77,(.60,.48,.33,1)),(1,(.30,.32,.27,1))]:
    e=ramp.color_ramp.elements[0] if pos==0 else ramp.color_ramp.elements.new(pos)
    e.color=col
l.new(tex.outputs['Fac'],ramp.inputs[0])
l.new(ramp.outputs['Color'],bs.inputs['Base Color'])
bump=n.new('ShaderNodeBump'); bump.inputs['Strength'].default_value=.14; bump.inputs['Distance'].default_value=.035
l.new(tex.outputs['Fac'],bump.inputs['Height']); l.new(bump.outputs['Normal'],bs.inputs['Normal'])
for ob in bpy.data.objects:
    if ob.type=='MESH' and ('wallpaper' in ob.name):
        ob.data.materials.clear(); ob.data.materials.append(wallmat)
    if ob.type=='MESH' and any(s in ob.name for s in ['pillow','soft ivory','upholstered','chair back inset']):
        for p in ob.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
        sub=ob.modifiers.new('soft textile surface','SUBSURF'); sub.levels=2
        dis=ob.modifiers.new('subtle fabric wrinkles','DISPLACE')
        t=bpy.data.textures.new(ob.name+' fabric',type='CLOUDS')
        t.noise_scale=.12; t.noise_depth=2
        dis.texture=t; dis.strength=.018; dis.mid_level=.5
# Bright window glass supplies the luminous outdoor rectangles.
for ob in bpy.data.objects:
    if ob.type=='MESH' and 'luminous glass' in ob.name:
        mat=bpy.data.materials.new('window daylight '+ob.name); mat.use_nodes=True
        p=mat.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
        p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(.76,.91,.91,1)
        p.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value=(.76,.93,1,1)
        p.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value=2.5
        ob.data.materials.clear(); ob.data.materials.append(mat)

set_view((-4.35,-6.8,2.75),(-.02,1.05,1.43),lens=35,sensor=36)
area_emitter((-1.6,3.0,2.45),power=650,size=2.0,target=(.0,-.8,.4),color=(.80,.91,1))
area_emitter((-3.1,.0,3.0),power=180,size=3,target=(1,1,.7),color=(1,.88,.72))
world=bpy.context.scene.world
world.use_nodes=True
world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs[0].default_value=(.45,.48,.51,1)
world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs[1].default_value=.23
sc=bpy.context.scene
sc.render.engine='CYCLES'
sc.cycles.samples=48
sc.render.resolution_x=512
sc.render.resolution_y=341
sc.render.resolution_percentage=100
sc.view_settings.view_transform='AgX'
sc.view_settings.look='AgX - Medium High Contrast'
